card.title: One Thing Leads to Another
card.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This café chair wobbles. Let's take all the chairs apart and check their joints.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.

mechanism: A treats a wobble's narrowed cause and an opening deadline as reasons for a whole-cafe renovation.
confusable: Unlike fixing the diagnosed fault, A must expand the scope whenever B supplies a constraint.
comparison: D48-b turns floorboard identification into closure and counter redesign; D48-a turns connected cupboards into a kitchen emptying.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
